<figcaption id="fig-tiny-caption">A basic neural-network building block: inputs <i>x</i>, a weighted sum <i>Wx</i> + <i>b</i> whose weights <i>W</i> and bias <i>b</i> are learned parameters, a fixed nonlinear function σ, and the output <i>h</i>. Larger networks combine many learned transformations and nonlinear operations; this is the smallest example to keep in mind.</figcaption>
